description: Normalization V1.1 of equal_count_breath research thread after targeted ingest. Axes first. Overall normalize_one. Candidate is not canon. Canon: docs/practices/PRACTICE_TECHNIQUE_NORMALIZATION_V1_1.md

post_exhale_hold.definition_contrast: BHF, SFH, Marchant square, and CAVUHB write a post-exhale hold inside a four-phase or four-side structure. Marchant names 5:5 without holds as a different experimental condition, not as square.
post_exhale_hold.newcastle: absent_but_unaddressed. Uses square without a written post-exhale hold. Does not claim that omission makes a different method, and does not claim the hold is optional.
post_exhale_hold.why_not_unresolved: Omission without an identity claim does not refute definition/contrast.
post_exhale_hold.why_not_optional: No preferred-class variant statement (N-H2) exists in the ingested corpus.

equal_count.common: BHF, SFH, and Marchant square use equal counts, typically four, without arguing that equality is the method.
equal_count.not_necessary: CAVUHB uses the same label square for 4-4-6-2.
equal_count.why_not_identity_bearing: A preferred-class source uses the method-label with unequal side counts. N-E1 is not met.
equal_count.why_not_unresolved: N-E2 is locked: common-but-not-necessary may be inferred from this pattern.

why_normalize_one: Both axes are resolved: post-exhale hold required; equal count a common parameter.
Landscape had glued four-phase structure to equal timing. That cut was premature.
One technique remains: four timed phases including the post-exhale hold.
why_not_insufficient_evidence: Hold is resolved by N-H1. Clarity on equal_count is not the only reason this pass closes.
why_not_split_family: Newcastle is a naming inconsistency, not a second identity-bearing method.
Marchant 5:5 is a different named condition in that study, not a second landscape family.
CAVUHB is the same four-phase square label with a different timing parameter.

landscape_remap.from_hypothesis: four equal phases including pauses; ratio identity is the kernel
landscape_remap.to_hypothesis: four timed phases including a hold after inhale and after exhale; equal duration is a common parameter, not the kernel

not_in_kernel: Marchant 5:5 remains a different named condition in that study.
Newcastle three-phase square remains a naming inconsistency, not a variant.

expression_hypothesis.note: Probe 4-4-4-4 is compatible with the four-phase kernel. Type is not attested until canonical.
